what: Each letter goes into a mask cell and rises from 110% below. The delay is not by order but by distance from the center of the text block (the farthest letter gets .4 seconds), so letters stand up spreading like a wave from the center outward (.6s power2.out). Multi-line sentences also spread from the center as one block. Send an element fx:swap (detail.text or detail.html) and the current letters leave upward in the same wave (.28s power2.in, spread .18) and the new text rises in (.4s power3.out)
ease: Enter power2.out (power3.out when swapping) · exit power2.in

options.spread: Delay of the farthest letter (s), default 0.4
options.when: “view” (default — when it enters the screen) · “load” (immediately) · “manual” (when it receives fx:play)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Line (optional) — if absent, the whole element text becomes one line
options.fx:swap · fx:play · fx:done: Swap text · turn by hand · fx:done (bubbles) once everything has risen

use: First lineSecond row

from.where: shared.js initial (loader sentence — .6s power2.out spread .4) · initWorksScroll (bottom caption — drops out .28s and rises in .4s when the line changes) · initSingle (detail title)
